note: Both sets contain duplicates and generic-entity claims, but Set A has more serious misbindings: four claims bind instrument counts to garbled entities like 'n-axis telescope' or 'axis telescope', and two vague 'spacecraft' claims lose the mission identity. Set B's main errors are binding the 10 m focal length to 'mirror assembly dimension/diameter' and attributing the science instrument count to the mirror assembly rather than Lynx. Set B keeps the LUVOIR-A/LUVOIR-B, HabEx, Origins and Lynx values correctly bound and includes the focal length claim correctly, so it is the more faithful set overall.
